lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Si12Bi6 (Mg2Si2Bi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 143), with 30 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives all Bi, Mg, and Si centers 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.01 to 3.35 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component containing all 30 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis of 12-vertex coordination polyhedra reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Bi and Mg, and between Mg and Si polyhedra.
